title: Prior override on permuted canonical alphabets
question: As the fraction of training problems using conventional canonical numerals ('0'..'9' in order) increases, does the model still follow a permuted canonical alphabet in context at evaluation time, or does it fall back to the memorised canonical order? (Evaluated on the `permuted` split over `B >= 3` bases—with `permuted_base{b}` slices in `eval_splits.json` so `prior_intrusion` can be compared against each base's `1 / (B - 1)` chance share of in-alphabet value errors.)
